name: Protocol
one_liner: Turns a health claim into a personal 21-day self-experiment.
notes: UNCERTAIN identity: ChatGPT V2 describes 'Protocol' as an emerging Biohacker-OS that converts a health claim into a 21-day experiment; Claude separately lists a 'Protocol' among peptide trackers. May be two different products with the same name.

name: Function Health
one_liner: Membership lab testing: 100+ (V2: 160+) annual biomarkers plus partial re-test and proprietary biological age; V2 adds imaging.
notes: Sells tests and builds the dashboard on top; walled garden, the data is the lock-in (per source).

name: Superpower
one_liner: Lab-testing membership with biomarker + wearable + AI + protocols.
notes: Lab-first commercial platform; walled-garden model (per source).

name: SiPhox
one_liner: At-home blood testing for longevity/optimization with dashboard.
notes: Lab-first commercial platform (per source).

name: Mito
one_liner: Lab-first longevity testing platform with dashboard.
notes: Lab-first commercial; walled-garden model (per source).

name: One Twenty
one_liner: Longevity testing with quarterly cadence and wearable integration.
notes: Emphasizes quarterly test cadence + wearable integration; walled garden (per source).

name: InsideTracker
one_liner: Blood + DNA + wearable to personalized ranges and recommendations; InnerAge biological age from blood.
notes: Optimizes a given biomarker; does NOT do causal inference across multiple interventions (per source).

name: Lifeforce
one_liner: Longevity membership: blood testing, clinician review, supplements/hormone optimization.
notes: Lab-first commercial platform (per source).

name: Rejuvenation Olympics
one_liner: Public biological-age leaderboard ranking pace-of-aging, tied to TruDiagnostic epigenetic tests.
notes: Public profile + reputation exists — but on a single number, not the protocol that produced it. Tied to one expensive test vendor; has changed criteria/transparency (per source).

name: Longevity World Cup
one_liner: Free, open-source biological-age competition ranked on PhenoAge; explicitly independent, not a marketing funnel.
notes: Free and open source, PhenoAge-based; positioned as independent project. Still one-number-centric, not protocol-level (per source).

name: NOVOS
one_liner: Consumer longevity brand with a Top-100 biological-age leaderboard.
notes: Leaderboard tied to a supplement/test brand (per source).

name: Fasten Health
one_liner: Self-hosted personal health record aggregating providers via FHIR / SMART-on-FHIR.
notes: GPL-3 self-hosted PHR; candidate reusable substrate rather than something to rewrite (per source).

name: Mere Medical
one_liner: Self-hosted personal medical record aggregator (FHIR-based).
notes: Open-source self-hosted PHR aggregator; potential substrate layer (per source).

name: Open mHealth
one_liner: Open schemas/standards for mobile health data interoperability.
notes: Open mHealth data schemas; interoperability substrate (per source).

name: Open Wearables
one_liner: Open-source / self-hosted equivalent of Terra: unifies Garmin/Oura/Whoop/Apple into one API.
notes: MIT, self-hosted unified wearable API; buy-the-ingestion-layer candidate for a Biohacker OS (per source).

name: Heads Up Health
one_liner: Professional/clinic health dashboard: labs + wearables + medical devices + EHR + AI, incl. cohort outcomes.
notes: What a longevity clinic would use; built for the professional (500 patients), not the self-experimenter (per source).

name: Open Humans
one_liner: Personal-data repository + API + shareable Jupyter notebooks enabling reproducible n=1 experiments without exposing raw personal data.
notes: Philosophically the closest: data -> dataset -> hypothesis -> experiment -> research; importers for 23andMe/Fitbit/Withings/VCF/Oura/Nightscout/microbiome. Solved the hard part but never reached critical mass; alive but essentially stalled (per source).

name: Quantified Flu
one_liner: Open Humans community project tracking symptoms vs wearable data around illness.
notes: Participatory-research offshoot in the Open Humans orbit (per source).

name: openSNP
one_liner: Open repository where users share genotype (23andMe etc.) + phenotype data for research.
notes: Open genotype+phenotype data sharing; participatory-research ancestor (per source).

name: Personal Science Wiki
one_liner: Community wiki documenting personal-science / self-experimentation methods and projects.
notes: Knowledge base for the personal-science community (per source).

name: Bearable
one_liner: Symptom / N-of-1 tracker: interventions -> behaviors -> symptoms -> outcomes with correlations ('what changes when I do X?').
notes: Correlation engine for self-experiments; strong on symptom/intervention logging, not a full experiment system (per source).

name: Biolearn
one_liner: Python library for biological aging clocks; multi-modal, with automated testing against reference data.
notes: Ready-to-use clock code, permissive license; reusable scientific substrate (per source).

name: pyaging
one_liner: Python library integrating dozens of aging clocks with a PyTorch backend.
notes: Integrates many clocks (PyTorch); reusable library (per source).

name: ClockBase
one_liner: Resource/platform for epigenetic aging-clock computation and comparison.
notes: Named as an aging-clock resource (per source); details not specified.

name: methylCIPHER
one_liner: R package computing many DNA-methylation aging clocks.
notes: Methylation-clock toolkit (per source).

name: BioAge
one_liner: Library for computing biological-age measures from biomarker data.
notes: Biological-age computation library (per source).

name: protocols.io
one_liner: Platform for versioned, forkable, citable lab protocols.
notes: Relevant for the model, not the domain: versioned/forkable/citable protocol = the git metaphor of biohack.it (per source).

name: Benchling
one_liner: Cloud R&D platform / electronic lab notebook for life sciences.
notes: Enterprise ELN; cited as UX/model reference (per source).

name: SciNote
one_liner: Electronic lab notebook with open-source core.
notes: Open-core ELN (per source).

name: OpenWetWare
one_liner: Open wiki for sharing lab protocols and know-how among biology labs.
notes: Community protocol wiki; forkable/citable model (per source).

name: Guava
one_liner: 'Personal health OS': records, labs, meds, wearables, glucose, symptoms, sleep, nutrition, mood, PDFs, C-CDA, DICOM, genetics on one timeline with relationship search.
notes: Starts from the person, not the wearable (strength). Very US-healthcare-oriented, limited use for a European; API in early access (per source).

name: Exist.io
one_liner: Quantified-Self heir: correlates health, sleep, activity, productivity, mood, calendar across many sources.
notes: Imports Apple Health/Fitbit/Garmin/Oura/Withings/Strava + calendar/GitHub/RescueTime/mood. Correlation engine, not an experimentation system (per source).

name: Welltory
one_liner: HRV-centric app (stress, activity) reading Apple Health / Health Connect / Samsung Health.
notes: HRV/stress focus; explicitly not a medical app, does not ingest medical data (per source).

name: HRV4Training
one_liner: Vertical HRV app with BT sensors (Polar H7/H10) and published validation studies.
notes: Serious for sports biohacking; HRV + stress + performance (per source).

name: Bevel
one_liner: Intelligence layer over Apple Health: recovery, strain, sleep ('WHOOP without WHOOP').
notes: Great UX, not a biohacker tool in the strict sense (per source).

name: Athlytic
one_liner: Apple Watch recovery/exertion/sleep intelligence.
notes: WHOOP-style intelligence over Apple Health; UX reference (per source).

name: Cronometer
one_liner: Detailed nutrition database (micronutrients, vitamins, minerals, amino/lipids); exchanges glucose/BP/HRV/SpO2/sleep/weight via Health Connect.
notes: Best-in-class nutrition data; interoperates via Health Connect (per source).

name: Terra
one_liner: Unified health API: hundreds of wearable/sensor/lab sources with realtime streaming and webhooks.
notes: Infrastructure (★★★★★). Unifies Garmin/Fitbit/Oura/WHOOP/Apple/Dexcom/Cronometer + CGM + blood biomarkers; buy-the-ingestion-layer candidate (per source).

name: Metriport
one_liner: Open-source, FHIR-native medical data platform: EHR, clinical history, C-CDA, PDF, FHIR R4, healthcare networks.
notes: Infrastructure (★★★★★). Open-source FHIR-native medical data; ingestion-layer candidate (per source).

name: Human API
one_liner: REST API aggregating medical records, labs, pharmacy, wearable data.
notes: Partial competitor of Terra/Metriport (per source).

name: Aurboda
one_liner: Personal data warehouse (PostgreSQL) queryable via MCP.
notes: Emerging Biohacker-OS primitive: PostgreSQL personal data warehouse queryable via MCP (per source).

name: Android Health Connect
one_liner: Android on-device health data store that also structures medical-record data.
notes: Cross-app health data layer; V2 notes it also structures medical-record data (per source).

name: Outliyr
one_liner: Self-experimentation OS: baseline, N-of-1 experiments, wearables, labs, genetics/epigenetics, supplement stack, 'AI Personal Scientist', MCP to ChatGPT/Claude.
notes: Emerging 'Biohacker OS' category (born 2026). Closest commercial framing to a full self-experimentation OS (per source).

name: Trialist
one_liner: Runs N-of-1 experiments locally on top of Apple Health.
notes: Emerging Biohacker-OS: local N-of-1 experiments over Apple Health (per source).

name: SelfDecode
one_liner: 1,500+ DNA reports, 4,000+ lab markers, 200M+ variants, polygenic risk scores; suggests tests/supplements/lifestyle; (2026) uses DNA + prior results to suggest which biomarkers to measure.
notes: Genotype -> risk -> recommendation; NOT hypothesis -> intervention -> measurement -> causal inference (per source).

name: Promethease
one_liner: Generates a personal genetic report by matching raw DNA against the SNPedia literature.
notes: Variant interpretation from raw DNA (per source).

name: SNPedia
one_liner: Wiki/database of SNPs and their reported phenotypic associations.
notes: Knowledge base powering Promethease reports (per source).

name: 23andMe
one_liner: Consumer DNA testing with ancestry + health reports; exportable raw genotype.
notes: Common raw-genotype source imported by other tools (per source).

name: Python / R / Jupyter
one_liner: General-purpose data-science stack for arbitrarily sophisticated personal analysis.
notes: For the technically capable, still the most powerful option (★★★★★) (per source).

name: VEP
one_liner: Annotates and predicts the effect of genomic variants (WGS/VCF).
notes: Advanced-biohacker variant analysis (per source).

name: OpenCRAVAT
one_liner: Modular variant annotation and interpretation platform (WGS/VCF/PRS).
notes: Advanced variant analysis (per source).

name: PLINK
one_liner: Whole-genome association analysis toolset (PRS, QC).
notes: PRS/variant analysis for advanced biohackers (per source).

name: bcftools
one_liner: Command-line utilities for variant calling and VCF/BCF manipulation.
notes: Core VCF tooling (per source).

name: Gene.iobio
one_liner: Interactive web tool for real-time variant exploration.
notes: Interactive variant exploration (per source).

name: Biomesight
one_liner: Gut-microbiome testing with dashboards and community reference ranges.
notes: Microbiome testing (per source).

name: Ombre
one_liner: Consumer gut-microbiome testing with recommendations.
notes: Microbiome testing (per source).

name: Viome
one_liner: Microbiome + RNA testing with food/supplement recommendations.
notes: Microbiome/RNA testing with recommendations (per source).

name: Levels
one_liner: CGM-based metabolic app: glucose + food + exercise; V2 adds sleep + activity + labs + DEXA + health records.
notes: Expanding from glucose toward a broader metabolic dashboard (per source).

name: Signos
one_liner: CGM app pairing glucose with meals/exercise for weight/metabolic goals.
notes: CGM-driven metabolic coaching (per source).

name: Dexcom
one_liner: Continuous glucose monitoring hardware + app; a common CGM data source.
notes: CGM sensor ecosystem; feeds other platforms (per source).

name: FreeStyle Libre
one_liner: Abbott continuous glucose monitoring sensor + app.
notes: CGM sensor ecosystem (per source).

name: January AI
one_liner: AI metabolic app predicting glucose response, optionally without a sensor.
notes: AI glucose prediction (per source).

name: Nightscout
one_liner: Open-source, self-hosted CGM data platform (DIY diabetes community).
notes: Open-source self-hosted CGM stack; DIY ethos aligned with biohack.it (per source).

name: Oura
one_liner: Ring wearable for sleep/recovery/readiness with API.
notes: Sleep/recovery wearable; common data source with an API (per source).

name: WHOOP
one_liner: Strap wearable for recovery/strain/sleep with subscription model.
notes: Recovery/strain wearable; UX reference (per source).

name: Eight Sleep
one_liner: Smart mattress/pod tracking sleep and controlling temperature.
notes: Sleep hardware ecosystem (per source).

name: Sleep Cycle
one_liner: Phone-based sleep-tracking and smart-alarm app.
notes: Consumer sleep tracker (per source).

name: AutoSleep
one_liner: Apple Watch automatic sleep-tracking app.
notes: Apple Watch sleep tracking (per source).

name: Cardiogram
one_liner: App applying analytics to heart-rate data from wearables.
notes: Heart-rate analytics (per source).

name: Qardio
one_liner: Connected blood-pressure/ECG devices with companion app.
notes: Connected cardio devices (per source).

name: Withings
one_liner: Connected scales/watches/BP monitors with health app + API; common data source.
notes: Broad connected-device ecosystem, frequently imported by aggregators (per source).

name: Garmin
one_liner: Sports/activity wearables with health metrics and developer API.
notes: Major wearable data source (per source).

name: Apple Health
one_liner: Apple's on-device health data hub aggregating apps/wearables.
notes: Central iOS health hub other apps build on (per source).

name: MacroFactor
one_liner: Adaptive macro/nutrition coaching app with dynamic energy expenditure.
notes: Nutrition/macro tracking (per source).

name: MyFitnessPal
one_liner: Large-database calorie/macro food logger.
notes: Mainstream food logger (per source).

name: ZOE
one_liner: Personalized nutrition program combining microbiome + CGM + blood-fat testing.
notes: Personalized-nutrition program using microbiome + CGM + blood testing (per source).

name: Muse
one_liner: EEG headband for meditation/neurofeedback with app.
notes: Consumer EEG neurofeedback (per source).

name: BrainHQ
one_liner: Cognitive-training exercise platform (Posit Science).
notes: Brain-training exercises (per source).

name: Sens.ai
one_liner: Multi-modal EEG neurofeedback + brain-stimulation headset.
notes: Neurofeedback + stimulation device (per source).

name: biohack.it
one_liner: Non-profit, AGPL-3.0, free platform making intervention -> biomarker computable AND public, toward distributed self-organised n-of-1 trials.
notes: REFERENCE ROW (from biohack.it positioning spec, not the two sources). Open data by default incl. gVCF + raw lab reports behind heightened consent; standards-coded (RxNorm/ATC, LOINC/UCUM, HL7 FHIR internal, OMOP export). Differentiator is the open-data / research side, not the consumer tracker. Deep SWOT vs these tools is a separate pending step.
